name: nordic-fund-day/pitch-showcase
title: Pitch Showcase
description: Full-bleed background image section with heading, description card, CTA, and horizontally scrollable sector cards with SVG icons.

descriptionText.default: 12 carefully selected Nordic and Baltic companies take the stage — prepared to connect with the right investors. Alongside the pitches, a tailored stage program brings targeted insights, fireside chats, and investor perspectives — adding context, quality, and direction to the deal flow.
